items.data_sentence: I've got whole-blood microarrays from 18 kidney transplant recipients, each sampled before surgery and three months after, plus TF motif and protein interaction priors.
items.purpose_sentence: Which transcription factors shift their targets the most between the two draws?
items.prompt: I've got whole-blood microarrays from 18 kidney transplant recipients, each sampled before surgery and three months after, plus TF motif and protein interaction priors. Which transcription factors shift their targets the most between the two draws?
must_include: a per-TF comparison of targeting (e.g., out-degree or activity) between the pre- and post-transplant samples
that the comparison respects pairing within recipients (paired test or within-person differences)
that the statistical test is a step outside the network tools
red_flags: treating the pre and post samples as independent groups
recommending miRNA-based tools (PUMA, LIONESS-PUMA) without miRNA data
ranking TFs by raw edge-weight differences with no significance assessment

items.data_sentence: I've got whole-blood microarrays from 18 kidney transplant recipients, each sampled before surgery and three months after, plus TF motif and protein interaction priors.
items.purpose_sentence: I'd like to rank the recipients by how much their regulatory networks rewired after transplant.
items.prompt: I've got whole-blood microarrays from 18 kidney transplant recipients, each sampled before surgery and three months after, plus TF motif and protein interaction priors. I'd like to rank the recipients by how much their regulatory networks rewired after transplant.
must_include: one network (or TF activity profile) per sample, not only one aggregate per time point
a within-recipient post-minus-pre difference used to rank the recipients
red_flags: only aggregate per-time-point networks, which cannot rank individuals
answering with a cohort-level test instead of a per-recipient ranking

items.data_sentence: I've got whole-blood microarrays from 18 kidney transplant recipients, each sampled before surgery and three months after, plus TF motif and protein interaction priors.

presenting a pre/post network difference as proof of causation

items.data_sentence: Lung RNA-seq from 12 wild-type and 12 Nrf2-knockout mice after two weeks of cigarette smoke exposure, plus mouse TF motif and protein interaction priors.
